podcast.body: This self-titled album was released on May 21, 2010, marking the band's return to recording after a nine-year hiatus since "Shangri-La Dee Da." Its release followed a successful 2008-2009 reunion tour and was spurred by Atlantic Records' suggestion to capitalize on the regained momentum. "The result was a self-titled album released on May 21, 2010."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
